opening.quote: Good morning, thank you far calling Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne. How can I help you?
opening.comment: The greeting gives both the agent's name and the company name, so this criterion is met.

verification.quote: Could your give me the order number or your postcode, so I can check the order?
verification.comment: The agent asked for the order number or postcode but never confirmed the caller's full name plus one of those before looking up and discussing the order; the caller gave only "Tom Dekker" and order 845302 was then read back, so the requirement was not fully met.

understanding.quote: Thank you, tim. Yes, I can sea order 845302 for a bedding set, delivered 9 working days later thans planned.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the late-delivery issue and the order number without asking again for information already given, so this criterion is met.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, I can sea order 845302 for a bedding set, delivered 9 working days later thans planned.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent did not state a delivery window or check it against policy; the 10-working-day lost-parcel rule is not relevant, and the €10 goodwill voucher is within the allowed limit, so no incorrect statement was made.

process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller on return, so the hold step was not followed.

communication.quote: I'm sorry it was so late, Tom, I understand that's frustrating went you're waiting in.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the caller's frustration about the late delivery, so this criterion is met.

closing.comment: The agent answered "Yes." but did not confirm what happens next for the voucher or ask if there was anything else, nor close politely, so the closing was incomplete.
